blocks.en: The seven blocks the protectant passes through form one loop: the dose the model sets, the light plate, the cells, the bioreactor, the plants, and back to the model. Field sensors, protein design, the photometer and the digital twin feed that loop.
blocks.zh: 保護劑經過的七個區塊構成一個迴路：模型定下的劑量、光照板、細胞、生物反應器、植物，再回到模型。田間感測器、蛋白質設計、光度計與數位孿生則匯入這個迴路。

blocks.en: Section through one well, to scale. The LED sits in its socket in the LED holder; above it the culture tube stands in a 17 mm bore of the black tube holder. Its light (green) goes up into the culture. Light leaving at an angle meets the 1 mm black wall to the next bore and stops there.
blocks.zh: 單一孔的剖面，按比例繪製。LED 裝在 LED 支架上的燈座裡；它上方，培養試管立在黑色試管支架的 17 mm 孔中。它的光（綠色）向上進入培養物。斜向射出的光碰到通往下一個孔的 1 mm 黑色牆面，就在那裡停住。

blocks.en: The array from above: six columns of four wells on an 18 mm grid. From the left, a green and a red column at the low tier, then at the mid tier, then at the high tier, drawn brighter as the tier rises. One column, outlined, is one light condition, with four matched LEDs under four tubes. Under the array, three MOSFETs, one per tier, each wired to its green and its red column.
blocks.zh: 陣列由上俯視：六欄，每欄四個孔，排在 18 mm 的格點上。由左而右，先是低強度層級的一欄綠光與一欄紅光，接著是中強度層級，再接著是高強度層級，層級愈高畫得愈亮。以外框標出的一欄就是一種光照條件，四顆配對的 LED 位於四支試管下方。陣列下方有三顆 MOSFET，一個層級一顆，各自接到它的綠光欄與紅光欄。

blocks.en: A wavelength scale from 340 to 720 nanometers. The photometer works at 600 nm, between the CcaS green peak near 535 nm and red peak near 670 nm. Most of the medium absorbs in the blue, and proteins and nucleic acids absorb further into the ultraviolet, off the left of the scale.
blocks.zh: 一條從 340 到 720 奈米的波長尺。光度計工作在 600 nm，位於 CcaS 約 535 nm 的綠光波峰與約 670 nm 的紅光波峰之間。培養基大多吸收在藍光區，蛋白質與核酸的吸收則更往紫外延伸，落在尺的左端之外。

blocks.en: Plan of the Slim photometer's bench from its CAD, cut at the fibers' height, to scale, light running left to right. The two fibers come in from the fiber illuminator (amber) and part in the open bay. The sample fiber (green) runs straight on; its tip, 1 mm from the flow cuvette, shines across the culture and through a 3.5 by 2.5 mm window onto the sample sensor. The reference fiber (blue) turns 90 degrees; its tip shines across a 5.6 mm empty chamber and through an identical window onto the reference sensor.
blocks.zh: Slim 光度計光學平台的俯視圖，取自它的 CAD，在光纖高度處剖開，按比例繪製，光由左往右走。兩條光纖從光纖光源（琥珀色）進來，在開放區中分開。樣品光纖（綠色）直走下去；它的端面距流通比色槽 1 mm，光橫穿培養液，再經一個 3.5 × 2.5 mm 的窗口射到樣品感測器上。參考光纖（藍色）轉 90 度；它的端面橫穿一個 5.6 mm 的空腔，再經一個完全相同的窗口射到參考感測器上。

blocks.en: Section through the Pro photometer's optical axis, from its CAD, to scale, light running left to right. The 600 nm LED's beam (amber) is made parallel by the lens and narrowed by the slit; at the 90:10 beam splitter 90 percent goes on (green) through the 2 mm flow cuvette to the sample sensor and 10 percent turns 90 degrees (blue) to the reference sensor. A bar under it marks the three regions: LED housing 38 mm, light-travel region 117 mm, sensor region 62 mm.
blocks.zh: 沿 Pro 光度計光軸的剖面，取自它的 CAD，按比例繪製，光由左往右走。600 nm LED 的光束（琥珀色）由透鏡變平行，再由狹縫收窄；在 90:10 分光鏡處，90% 繼續前行（綠色），穿過 2 mm 的流通比色槽到樣品感測器，10% 轉 90 度（藍色）到參考感測器。下方有一條橫條標出三個區段：LED 殼 38 mm、光行進區 117 mm、感測器區 62 mm。

blocks.en: The component side of the photometer's soldered perfboard, drawn to scale: six columns, 01 to 06, and 28 rows. Down the left edge, three two-pin headers go to the Arduino: 3.3 V and ground in rows B and A at the top, SCL and SDA in rows Z and Y, 5 V and D3 in rows Q and P. Down the right edge, two five-pin headers take the sample sensor (rows B to X) and the reference sensor (rows W to S), each pin in the order VCC, GND, SCL, SDA, ADDR, and a two-pin header in rows Q and P takes the LED. Red jumpers supply 3.3 V from row B to both sensors' VCC and to the sample sensor's ADDR; black jumpers connect ground to both sensors and down to row S; two green jumpers link SCL and two blue ones SDA to both sensors. The 330 ohm resistor lies in row Q, the 10 kilo-ohm in row O and the 1.2 kilo-ohm in row M; the PN2222 transistor lies face up below them, its emitter, base and collector in N04, N05 and N06.
blocks.zh: 光度計焊接萬用板的元件面，按比例繪製：六欄，01 到 06，二十八列。沿左緣有三個二針排針接到 Arduino：最上面 B 列與 A 列是 3.3 V 與接地，Z 列與 Y 列是 SCL 與 SDA，Q 列與 P 列是 5 V 與 D3。沿右緣有兩個五針排針，分別接樣品感測器（B 列到 X 列）與參考感測器（W 列到 S 列），每個針位依 VCC、GND、SCL、SDA、ADDR 的順序排列；Q 列與 P 列的一個二針排針接 LED。紅色跳線從 B 列把 3.3 V 供到兩顆感測器的 VCC 與樣品感測器的 ADDR；黑色跳線把接地接到兩顆感測器，並往下接到 S 列；兩條綠色跳線把 SCL、兩條藍色跳線把 SDA 接到兩顆感測器。330 歐姆電阻放在 Q 列，10 千歐姆放在 O 列，1.2 千歐姆放在 M 列；PN2222 電晶體正面朝上放在它們下方，射極、基極與集極分別在 N04、N05 與 N06。

blocks.en: The solder side of the same board, seen from below, so its columns run 06 to 01 from the left. Solder bridges join each header pin to the hole beside it, where a jumper or a part lead comes through. Row S joins the reference sensor's ADDR pin to ground, and from it two traces run down: column 04 to the transistor's emitter and column 03 to the 10 kilo-ohm resistor. The LED's minus pin runs down column 06 to the collector, the 10 kilo-ohm, the base and the 1.2 kilo-ohm meet in column 05, and D3 runs down column 01 to the 1.2 kilo-ohm.
blocks.zh: 同一塊板子的焊接面，由下方觀看，因此它的欄由左而右是 06 到 01。焊橋把每一個排針針位接到旁邊那個孔，跳線或零件的接腳就從那裡穿出。S 列把參考感測器的 ADDR 針位接到接地，並從它往下走出兩條線路：04 欄到電晶體的射極，03 欄到 10 千歐姆電阻。LED 的負極針位沿 06 欄往下接到集極；10 千歐姆、基極與 1.2 千歐姆在 05 欄相接；D3 沿 01 欄往下接到 1.2 千歐姆。

blocks.en: Wiring of the photometer as described in section 9.1. Arduino pin D3 drives the base of a PN2222 transistor through a 1.2 kilo-ohm resistor; a 10 kilo-ohm resistor joins the base to the emitter. The LED runs from 5 volts, through a 330 ohm resistor, to the collector. Both GY-302 lux sensors share 3.3 volts, SDA and SCL. The emitter, both sensor grounds and the Arduino ground meet on one shared ground.
blocks.zh: 第 9.1 節所述的光度計接線。Arduino 的 D3 腳位透過一顆 1.2 千歐姆電阻驅動 PN2222 電晶體的基極；一顆 10 千歐姆電阻把基極接到射極。LED 從 5 伏特出發，經一顆 330 歐姆電阻接到集極。兩顆 GY-302 照度感測器共用 3.3 伏特、SDA 與 SCL。射極、兩顆感測器的接地與 Arduino 的接地匯集在同一個共用接地上。
